column1: # nhc1_ppsnark_k1x10.trace.tsv: every Poseidon-RO squeeze and Keccak-transcript operation performed by nova-snark 0.76.0 CompressedSNARK::verify on nhc1_ppsnark_k1x10.proof.hex, in order (RO events), then the two Spartan transcripts.
# ro <field> <num_bits> <start_with_one> <output> <absorbed elements since the previous squeeze, comma separated, 32 B LE hex>

# field fp = RO over the Pallas base field (E1::RO: hasher2 and the primary NIFS); fq = RO over the Vesta base field (E2::RO: hasher and the secondary NIFS). Each RO object is created fresh (new), so there is no carry-over between records of one verification; within one record the elements listed are exactly the absorbs before that squeeze.

# Order: [hasher (E2 RO): pp_digest, num_steps, z0.., zn.., r_U_secondary (absorb_in_ro), ri_primary] -> record 1 (fq, 250 bits); [hasher2 (E1 RO): scalar_as_base(pp_digest), num_steps, 0, 0, r_U_primary, ri_secondary] -> record 2 (fp, 250 bits); then NIFS Uf secondary (fq, 128 bits), NIFSRelaxed Un secondary (fq, 128), NIFSRelaxed Un primary (fp, 128).
# te_begin <engine> <label>        a new Keccak256Transcript for the Spartan verifier of the primary (pallas) or secondary (vesta) instance; label RelaxedR1CSSNARK
# te_absorb <label> <bytes hex>    exact to_transcript_bytes appended after the label
# Challenges are in the engine's scalar field (pallas -> fq, vesta -> fp).
